title: "05: Exit survey responses"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: true
---

The post-test survey (paper, "Post-test survey and group identification
check") asks whether the instructions were understood, how much participants
identified with and felt close to their Phase 1 group (7-point items), whether
they noticed their group developing its own way of describing the pictures,
their strategy, and, on a second page, whether they felt they were playing with
other humans, plus age, gender, education, pay fairness, and open feedback.
Players removed at the Phase 1 accuracy check complete the survey too.

An item nobody answered is reported as "not collected".

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here("analysis", "config.R"))
list2env(load_tables(), envir = globalenv())

survey <- exit_survey_responses(players, games)
cat("Respondents (any survey field answered):", nrow(survey), "of",
    nrow(players |> semi_join(games |> filter(!is.na(condition)), by = "gameId")), "players in real games\n")

```

```{r dataset-banner, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
dataset_banner(games = games)
```

# Who responded

```{r response-summary}
if (nrow(survey) == 0) {
  cat("No survey responses in this dataset.\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(
    survey |>
      group_by(condition, respondent, .drop = FALSE) |>
      summarise(
        respondents = n(),
        page2 = if (has_field(survey, "age")) sum(!is.na(age)) else NA_integer_,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      filter(respondents > 0),
    caption = "Respondents by condition and whether they completed the game (page2: also answered the demographics page)"
  ))
}
```

# Group identification and closeness

The two 7-point items (1 = not at all, 7 = very much). Descriptive by
condition with a Kruskal-Wallis test across conditions; the paper treats these
as a manipulation check, not a hypothesis test.

```{r likert-items}
likert_items <- c(groupIdentification = "Sense of being part of the Phase 1 group",
                  groupCloseness = "Closeness to the Phase 1 group")
present <- names(likert_items)[vapply(names(likert_items), function(f) has_field(survey, f), logical(1))]
if (length(present) == 0) {
  cat("Not collected in this dataset.\n")
} else {
  for (item in present) {
    cat(sprintf("\n=== %s ===\n", likert_items[[item]]))
    print(knitr::kable(likert_by_condition(survey, item), digits = 2))
    d <- survey |> filter(!is.na(.data[[item]]))
    if (n_distinct(d$condition) >= 2) print(kruskal.test(d[[item]] ~ d$condition))
  }
}
```

# Awareness of group-specific language

```{r group-language}
if (!has_field(survey, "groupLanguage")) {
  cat("Not collected in this dataset.\n")
} else {
  gl <- survey |>
    filter(!is.na(groupLanguage)) |>
    group_by(condition, .drop = FALSE) |>
    summarise(n = n(), yes = sum(groupLanguage == "yes"), prop_yes = yes / n, .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n > 0)
  print(knitr::kable(gl, digits = 2, caption = "Noticed the group developing its own way of describing the pictures"))
  d <- survey |> filter(!is.na(groupLanguage))
  if (n_distinct(d$condition) >= 2 && n_distinct(d$groupLanguage) >= 2) {
    print(suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(droplevels(d$condition), d$groupLanguage))))
  }
}
```

# Felt they were playing with humans

Games in which any respondent answered "no" are flagged for detailed
inspection of their chat logs (paper, "AI detection"). A flag is a prompt to
inspect, not an exclusion: exclusions are decided from the chat logs and the
other engagement indicators and recorded in `participant_exclusions.csv`
(see `00_data_overview.qmd`). In the mixed conditions Phase 2 partners are
anonymous, with names masked and avatars reassigned each trial, so a "no" is
expected to be more common there for reasons unrelated to bots; the second
table splits the rate by Phase 2 structure.

```{r felt-human}
if (!has_field(survey, "feltHuman")) {
  cat("Not collected in this dataset.\n")
} else {
  fh <- survey |>
    filter(!is.na(feltHuman)) |>
    group_by(condition, .drop = FALSE) |>
    summarise(n = n(), said_no = sum(feltHuman == "no"), prop_no = said_no / n, .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n > 0)
  print(knitr::kable(fh, digits = 2, caption = "Respondents who did not feel they were playing with humans"))
  fh_mixing <- survey |>
    filter(!is.na(feltHuman)) |>
    mutate(phase2 = ifelse(
      condition == "refer_separated",
      "same groups throughout (separated)",
      "reshuffled with masked identities (mixed)"
    )) |>
    group_by(phase2) |>
    summarise(n = n(), said_no = sum(feltHuman == "no"), prop_no = said_no / n, .groups = "drop")
  print(knitr::kable(fh_mixing, digits = 3, caption = "The same, by Phase 2 structure"))
  flags <- felt_human_flags(survey)
  if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
    cat("\nNo game flagged: every respondent felt they were playing with humans.\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("\n%d game(s) flagged for inspection:\n", nrow(flags)))
    print(knitr::kable(flags |> mutate(gameId = substr(gameId, 1, 10))))
    group_flags <- felt_human_flags(survey, level = "group")
    cat(sprintf("\n%d original group(s) flagged for inspection of their chat logs:\n", nrow(group_flags)))
    print(knitr::kable(group_flags |> mutate(gameId = substr(gameId, 1, 10)) |>
                         select(condition, gameId, originalGroup, respondents, said_no, players_saying_no)))
  }
}
```

# Comprehension and pay fairness

```{r comprehension-fairness}
if (has_field(survey, "understood")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(understood)) |> count(condition, understood),
                     caption = "Understood the instructions"))
}
if (has_field(survey, "fair")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(fair), fair != "") |>
                       select(condition, originalGroup, respondent, fair) |> arrange(condition, originalGroup),
                     caption = "Was the pay fair (free text)"))
}
```

# Demographics

```{r demographics}
if (has_field(survey, "age")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(age)) |> group_by(condition, .drop = FALSE) |>
                       summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(age), median = median(age), min = min(age), max = max(age), .groups = "drop") |>
                       filter(n > 0), digits = 1, caption = "Age by condition"))
}
if (has_field(survey, "gender")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(gender)) |> count(condition, gender), caption = "Gender by condition"))
}
if (has_field(survey, "education")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(education)) |> count(condition, education), caption = "Education by condition"))
}
if (!any(vapply(c("age", "gender", "education"), function(f) has_field(survey, f), logical(1)))) {
  cat("No demographics in this dataset.\n")
}
```

```{r free-text}
if (has_field(survey, "strategy")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(strategy), strategy != "") |>
                       select(condition, originalGroup, respondent, strategy) |> arrange(condition, originalGroup),
                     caption = "Strategy (free text)"))
}
if (has_field(survey, "feedback")) {
  print(knitr::kable(survey |> filter(!is.na(feedback), feedback != "") |>
                       select(condition, originalGroup, respondent, feedback) |> arrange(condition, originalGroup),
                     caption = "Open feedback"))
}
```
